description: This file defines the Spring Boot configuration for the Eclipse Hono AMQP protocol adapter, including bean definitions, configuration property mappings, and customizations related to adapter setup and metrics.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for the Hono AMQP protocol adapter, providing bean definitions, property configuration, and metrics setup.

methods.name: vertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates and provides a bean instance of VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter with prototype scope.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the ClientConfigProperties instance for downstream sender, setting its name if not already set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the RequestResponseClientConfigProperties for registration client, setting its name if not already set.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the RequestResponseClientConfigProperties for credentials client, setting its name if not already set.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the RequestResponseClientConfigProperties for tenant client, setting its name if the config is not null.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Exposes the Hono AMQP adapter properties as a Spring bean, mapped to the prefix 'hono.amqp'.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory bean for producing AMQP adapter instances, targeting the bean named by BEAN_NAME_VERTX_BASED_AMQP_PROTOCOL_ADAPTER.

methods.name: connectionEventProducer
methods.description: Provides a bean for a connection event producer, defaulting to an instance of LoggingConnectionEventProducer.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Customizes the MeterRegistry with common tags related to the protocol adapter type.
